name: dobe_stalk_hug
desc: Seen from behind, it is hugging a very wide, thick pillar standing right in front of it: both huge arms spread wide and curve forward around the pillar so the forearms and hands disappear around the far side (not visible), elbows out wide to the sides, broad back hunched forward, chest pressed forward, head tilted to one side nuzzling. Keep the same goo stalk below the waist running off the bottom edge (no puddle), the same back, head, colors, yellow marble, outline and pixel art style. Transparent background.
